question: Write the conditions for constructive and destructive interference in terms of path difference in Young's double-slit experiment.

options.A: Constructive interference: $\Delta x=\left(n+\dfrac12\right)\lambda$; destructive interference: $\Delta x=n\lambda$.
options.B: Constructive interference: $\Delta x=\dfrac{n\lambda}{2}$; destructive interference: $\Delta x=2n\lambda$.
options.C: Constructive interference occurs only for $\Delta x=0$; destructive interference occurs for $\Delta x=\lambda$.
options.D: Constructive interference (bright fringe) occurs for $\Delta x=n\lambda$, and destructive interference (dark fringe) occurs for $\Delta x=\left(n+\dfrac12\right)\lambda$.
